#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Health Monitor Script
# Monitors application health endpoints and restarts unhealthy services.

LOG_FILE="${LOG_FILE:-/var/log/health_monitor.log}"
CHECK_INTERVAL="${CHECK_INTERVAL:-30}"
MAX_RETRIES="${MAX_RETRIES:-3}"
RETRY_DELAY="${RETRY_DELAY:-5}"

# Services to monitor: "name|health_url|restart_command"
SERVICES=(
  "webapp|http://localhost:8080/health|systemctl restart webapp"
  "api|http://localhost:3000/health|systemctl restart api"
  "worker|http://localhost:5000/health|systemctl restart worker"
)

# Track consecutive failures per service
declare -A FAILURE_COUNTS

log() {
  local level="$1"
  shift
  local msg="[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] [$level] $*"
  echo "$msg" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

check_health() {
  local url="$1"
  local http_code
  http_code=$(curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 "$url" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
  [[ "$http_code" =~ ^2 ]]
}

restart_service() {
  local name="$1"
  local cmd="$2"
  log "WARN" "Restarting service: $name"
  if eval "$cmd" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1; then
    log "INFO" "Restart command succeeded for $name"
    return 0
  else
    log "ERROR" "Restart command failed for $name (exit code: $?)"
    return 1
  fi
}

monitor_service() {
  local entry="$1"
  IFS='|' read -r name url cmd <<< "$entry"
  local failures=${FAILURE_COUNTS[$name]:-0}

  if check_health "$url"; then
    if (( failures > 0 )); then
      log "INFO" "$name recovered after $failures failed check(s)"
    fi
    FAILURE_COUNTS[$name]=0
    return 0
  fi

  failures=$((failures + 1))
  FAILURE_COUNTS[$name]=$failures
  log "WARN" "$name health check failed ($failures/$MAX_RETRIES)"

  if (( failures >= MAX_RETRIES )); then
    if restart_service "$name" "$cmd"; then
      log "INFO" "$name restarted; resetting failure count"
      FAILURE_COUNTS[$name]=0
    else
      log "ERROR" "$name restart FAILED — will retry next cycle"
      FAILURE_COUNTS[$name]=$((MAX_RETRIES - 1))
    fi
  fi
}

cleanup() {
  log "INFO" "Health monitor shutting down (PID $$)"
  exit 0
}
trap cleanup SIGINT SIGTERM

main() {
  log "INFO" "Health monitor started (PID $$, interval=${CHECK_INTERVAL}s, max_retries=$MAX_RETRIES)"

  for entry in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
    IFS='|' read -r name _ _ <<< "$entry"
    FAILURE_COUNTS[$name]=0
  done

  while true; do
    for entry in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
      monitor_service "$entry" &
    done
    wait
    sleep "$CHECK_INTERVAL"
  done
}

main "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# =============================================================================
# Health Monitor — monitors services and restarts unhealthy ones
#
# Features:
#   - Continuous monitoring loop with configurable interval
#   - Consecutive-failure tracking to avoid flapping restarts
#   - HTTP health endpoint checks and systemd service status
#   - Log rotation (keeps last N lines when file exceeds size limit)
#   - Graceful shutdown on SIGINT / SIGTERM
#   - Works locally or over SSH (toggle REMOTE_MODE)
# =============================================================================

# --- Configuration -----------------------------------------------------------

REMOTE_MODE="${REMOTE_MODE:-false}"               # true = SSH to remote hosts

# Remote servers (only used when REMOTE_MODE=true)
# Format: "user@host:service1,service2"
SERVERS=(
    "deploy@10.0.1.10:nginx,app-server"
    "deploy@10.0.1.11:nginx,app-server"
    "deploy@10.0.1.12:postgres"
)

# Local services (only used when REMOTE_MODE=false)
# Format: "service_name|health_url|restart_command"
LOCAL_SERVICES=(
    "webapp|http://localhost:8080/health|systemctl restart webapp"
    "api|http://localhost:3000/health|systemctl restart api"
    "worker|http://localhost:5000/health|systemctl restart worker"
)

CHECK_INTERVAL=30                                   # Seconds between cycles
HEALTH_TIMEOUT=5                                    # HTTP request timeout (seconds)
MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES=3                          # Failures before restart
MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS=2                              # Restart retries per cycle
SSH_TIMEOUT=10                                      # SSH connect timeout
LOG_FILE="${LOG_FILE:-/var/log/health_monitor.log}"
LOG_MAX_SIZE=$((5 * 1024 * 1024))                   # Rotate at 5 MB
LOG_KEEP_LINES=5000                                 # Lines to keep after rotation

# --- State -------------------------------------------------------------------

declare -A FAILURE_COUNTS   # consecutive failures per service key
RUNNING=true

# --- Helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------

log() {
    local level="$1"; shift
    local msg="[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] [$$] [$level] $*"
    echo "$msg" >&2
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
}

rotate_log() {
    [[ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]] && return
    local size
    size=$(stat -c%s "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null) || return
    if (( size > LOG_MAX_SIZE )); then
        log "INFO" "Rotating log ($size bytes > $LOG_MAX_SIZE bytes)"
        local tmp="${LOG_FILE}.tmp"
        tail -n "$LOG_KEEP_LINES" "$LOG_FILE" > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null
        mv "$tmp" "$LOG_FILE"
    fi
}

cleanup() {
    RUNNING=false
    log "INFO" "Shutting down (PID $$)"
}
trap cleanup SIGINT SIGTERM

# --- Remote helpers ----------------------------------------------------------

remote_exec() {
    local host="$1"; shift
    ssh -o ConnectTimeout="$SSH_TIMEOUT" \
        -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new \
        -o BatchMode=yes \
        "$host" "$@"
}

is_remote_service_active() {
    local host="$1" service="$2"
    remote_exec "$host" "systemctl is-active --quiet '$service'" 2>/dev/null
}

check_remote_http() {
    local host="$1"
    remote_exec "$host" \
        "curl -sf --max-time $HEALTH_TIMEOUT 'http://localhost:8080/health' >/dev/null 2>&1"
}

restart_remote_service() {
    local host="$1" service="$2"
    log "INFO" "$host: restarting '$service'..."
    remote_exec "$host" "sudo systemctl restart '$service'" 2>&1
}

# --- Local helpers -----------------------------------------------------------

check_local_http() {
    local url="$1"
    local code
    code=$(curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time "$HEALTH_TIMEOUT" "$url" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
    [[ "$code" =~ ^2 ]]
}

restart_local_service() {
    local cmd="$1"
    log "INFO" "Running: $cmd"
    eval "$cmd" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1
}

# --- Core logic --------------------------------------------------------------

# $1 = key (for failure tracking)
# $2 = human-readable label
# $3.. = check command (eval'd)
run_check() {
    local key="$1" label="$2"; shift 2
    local failures=${FAILURE_COUNTS[$key]:-0}

    if "$@"; then
        if (( failures > 0 )); then
            log "INFO" "$label recovered after $failures failed check(s)"
        fi
        FAILURE_COUNTS[$key]=0
        return 0
    fi

    failures=$((failures + 1))
    FAILURE_COUNTS[$key]=$failures
    log "WARN" "$label health check failed ($failures/$MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES)"

    if (( failures >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES )); then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

monitor_remote() {
    local entry="$1"
    IFS=':' read -r host service_list <<< "$entry"
    IFS=',' read -ra services <<< "$service_list"

    log "INFO" "Checking $host (services: ${services[*]})"

    for svc in "${services[@]}"; do
        local key="${host}:${svc}"
        if ! run_check "$key" "$host/$svc" is_remote_service_active "$host" "$svc"; then
            local attempt=0
            while (( attempt < MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS )); do
                ((attempt++))
                restart_remote_service "$host" "$svc"
                if is_remote_service_active "$host" "$svc"; then
                    log "INFO" "$host/$svc recovered after restart (attempt $attempt)"
                    FAILURE_COUNTS[$key]=0
                    break
                fi
                log "WARN" "$host/$svc still down after attempt $attempt"
            done
            if (( attempt >= MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS )) && ! is_remote_service_active "$host" "$svc"; then
                log "ERROR" "$host/$svc failed to recover after $MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS restart(s)"
                FAILURE_COUNTS[$key]=$((MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES - 1))
            fi
        fi
    done
}

monitor_local() {
    local entry="$1"
    IFS='|' read -r name url cmd <<< "$entry"

    if ! run_check "$name" "$name" check_local_http "$url"; then
        local attempt=0
        while (( attempt < MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS )); do
            ((attempt++))
            restart_local_service "$cmd"
            sleep 3
            if check_local_http "$url"; then
                log "INFO" "$name recovered after restart (attempt $attempt)"
                FAILURE_COUNTS[$name]=0
                break
            fi
            log "WARN" "$name still unhealthy after attempt $attempt"
        done
        if (( attempt >= MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS )) && ! check_local_http "$url"; then
            log "ERROR" "$name failed to recover after $MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS restart(s)"
            FAILURE_COUNTS[$name]=$((MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES - 1))
        fi
    fi
}

# --- Main --------------------------------------------------------------------

main() {
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG_FILE")"
    log "INFO" "=== Health monitor started (PID $$, interval=${CHECK_INTERVAL}s) ==="

    # Init failure counters
    if [[ "$REMOTE_MODE" == "true" ]]; then
        for entry in "${SERVERS[@]}"; do
            IFS=':' read -r host service_list <<< "$entry"
            IFS=',' read -ra services <<< "$service_list"
            for svc in "${services[@]}"; do
                FAILURE_COUNTS["${host}:${svc}"]=0
            done
        done
    else
        for entry in "${LOCAL_SERVICES[@]}"; do
            IFS='|' read -r name _ _ <<< "$entry"
            FAILURE_COUNTS["$name"]=0
        done
    fi

    while $RUNNING; do
        rotate_log

        if [[ "$REMOTE_MODE" == "true" ]]; then
            for entry in "${SERVERS[@]}"; do
                monitor_remote "$entry" &
            done
        else
            for entry in "${LOCAL_SERVICES[@]}"; do
                monitor_local "$entry" &
            done
        fi
        wait

        # Interruptible sleep
        local i=0
        while $RUNNING && (( i < CHECK_INTERVAL )); do
            sleep 1
            ((i++))
        done
    done

    log "INFO" "=== Health monitor stopped ==="
}

main "$@"

Script is syntactically valid and executable. Here's what it does:

**Monitoring modes** — set `REMOTE_MODE=true` to check services over SSH on remote hosts, or keep it `false` (default) to monitor local services via HTTP health endpoints and systemd.

**Key features:**
- **Consecutive failure tracking** — a service must fail `MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES` (default 3) checks in a row before a restart is triggered, preventing flapping
- **Restart retries** — up to `MAX_RESTART_ATTEMPTS` restarts per cycle; if the service stays down, the failure counter stays high so the next cycle retries too
- **Log rotation** — automatically trims the log file when it exceeds 5 MB, keeping the last 5000 lines
- **Interruptible sleep** — responds to SIGINT/SIGTERM within 1 second instead of blocking for the full `CHECK_INTERVAL`
- **Parallel checks** — health checks for all services run concurrently in background subshells

**Configuration** — edit the arrays at the top of the script or override via environment variables (`LOG_FILE`, `CHECK_INTERVAL`, `REMOTE_MODE`).

**Local mode example** (default):
```bash
./health_monitor.sh
```

**Remote mode example**:
```bash
REMOTE_MODE=true ./health_monitor.sh
```

**Run as a daemon**:
```bash
nohup ./health_monitor.sh &
```
